verdict.rationale: Bench is a bookkeeping SaaS and service, so issuing scoped API credentials to an agent is a fair question. The evidence shows no API or credential-scoping feature. The only related claim is 'unlimited logins' for human account access, which is an adjacent feature, and probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
